SELECT s.student_name AS studentName,
convert(varchar(10), nxt.starts_at, 23) AS startDate, CASE ((datepart(dw, nxt.starts_at) + @@datefirst - 1) % 7) WHEN 0 THEN N'일요일' WHEN 1 THEN N'월요일' WHEN 2 THEN N'화요일' WHEN 3 THEN N'수요일' WHEN 4 THEN N'목요일' WHEN 5 THEN N'금요일' WHEN 6 THEN N'토요일' END AS startDayName, convert(varchar(5), nxt.starts_at, 108) AS startTime, convert(varchar(5), nxt.ends_at, 108) AS endTime,
convert(varchar(10), prv.record_date, 23) AS lastVisitDate, CASE ((datepart(dw, prv.record_date) + @@datefirst - 1) % 7) WHEN 0 THEN N'일요일' WHEN 1 THEN N'월요일' WHEN 2 THEN N'화요일' WHEN 3 THEN N'수요일' WHEN 4 THEN N'목요일' WHEN 5 THEN N'금요일' WHEN 6 THEN N'토요일' END AS lastVisitDayName, convert(varchar(5), prv.in_time, 108) AS checkIn, convert(varchar(5), coalesce(prv.out_time, prvres.ends_at), 108) AS checkOut,
pass.total_count AS passTotal, pass.remain_count AS passRemain, convert(varchar(10), pass.valid_until, 23) AS passValidUntil,
books.img1 AS bookImg1, books.img2 AS bookImg2, books.img3 AS bookImg3, books.img4 AS bookImg4
FROM erp_student s
-- 다음 예약: 끝나지 않은(진행중 포함) 가장 이른 슬롯 OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 ebsi.starts_at, ebsi.ends_at FROM erp_bookstore_reservation ebr JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance ebsi ON ebsi.slot_instance_id = ebr.slot_instance_id WHERE ebr.student_id = s.student_id AND ebr.status <> 'CANCELED' AND ebsi.ends_at >= getdate() ORDER BY ebsi.starts_at ASC ) nxt
-- 직전 diary (당일 포함) OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 ebd.in_time, ebd.out_time, ebd.record_date, ebd.record_time FROM erp_bookstore_diary ebd WHERE ebd.student_id = s.student_id AND ebd.record_date <= cast(getdate() AS date) ORDER BY ebd.record_date DESC, ebd.in_time DESC ) prv
-- 체크아웃 fallback: 그 diary 와 같은 날짜/회차 예약의 종료시간 OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 ebsi.ends_at FROM erp_bookstore_reservation ebr JOIN erp_bookstore_slot_instance ebsi ON ebsi.slot_instance_id = ebr.slot_instance_id WHERE ebr.student_id = s.student_id AND ebr.status <> 'CANCELED' AND ebsi.center_code = s.center_code AND ebsi.service_date = prv.record_date AND ebsi.seq = prv.record_time ORDER BY ebsi.starts_at DESC ) prvres
-- 활성 이용권 (회수 안 됨 + 유효기간 내, 가장 최근 부여분) -- -- valid_until IS NULL 을 함께 받는 이유(2026-09-15) — 만료일이 "첫 예약일부터 90일"로 -- 바뀌면서(2026-09-14) 결제 직후의 이용권은 기간이 아직 안 정해진 채(valid_from/until NULL) -- 대기한다. NULL 비교는 참이 되지 않으므로 조건을 그대로 두면 방금 산 이용권이 통째로 -- 빠져서 앱 메인에 "이용권 없음/0회"로 보인다. PassMapper.sumRemain 은 같은 이유로 이미 -- valid_from IS NULL 을 포함하고 있다 — 그쪽과 기준을 맞춘다. OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 p.total_count, p.remain_count, p.valid_until FROM erp_bookstore_pass p WHERE p.student_id = s.student_id AND p.revoked_at IS NULL AND (p.valid_until IS NULL OR p.valid_until >= cast(getdate() AS date)) ORDER BY p.granted_at DESC ) pass
-- 최근 독서 기록 이미지 4개 (최신순) OUTER APPLY ( SELECT max(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN book_img END) AS img1, max(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN book_img END) AS img2, max(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN book_img END) AS img3, max(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN book_img END) AS img4 FROM ( SELECT ebdd.book_img, row_number() OVER ( ORDER BY ebd2.record_date DESC, ebd2.record_time DESC, ebdd.id DESC ) AS rn FROM erp_bookstore_diary ebd2 JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail ebdd ON ebdd.diary_key = ebd2.diary_key WHERE ebd2.student_id = s.student_id AND ebd2.record_date <= cast(getdate() AS date) AND ebdd.book_img IS NOT NULL AND ebdd.book_img <> '' ) t WHERE rn <= 4 ) books
WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT TOP 4 convert(varchar(10), d.record_date, 23) FROM erp_bookstore_diary d WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId} AND d.record_date <= cast(dateadd(hour, 9, getutcdate()) AS date) ORDER BY d.record_date DESC

SELECT s.student_name AS studentName, isnull(day.bookCount, 0) AS bookCount, isnull(day.readMinutes, 0) AS readMinutes, day.correctRate AS correctRate, isnull(cum.totalBookCount, 0) AS totalBookCount FROM erp_student s
-- 그날 일지 상세 합계. 심화는 재도전으로 갱신되는 final 을 우선한다(diary_detail 주석). OUTER APPLY ( SELECT count(*) AS bookCount, sum(isnull(dd.read_minutes, 0)) AS readMinutes, CASE WHEN sum(isnull(dd.basic_total_cnt, 0) + isnull(dd.advanced_total_cnt, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cast(round( 100.0 * sum(isnull(coalesce(rl.final_correct_count, dd.basic_correct_cnt), 0) + isnull(coalesce(dd.advanced_final_correct_cnt, dd.advanced_correct_cnt), 0)) / sum(isnull(dd.basic_total_cnt, 0) + isnull(dd.advanced_total_cnt, 0)), 0) AS int) END AS correctRate FROM erp_bookstore_diary d JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd ON dd.diary_key = d.diary_key LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl ON rl.recommend_id = dd.recommend_id WHERE d.student_id = s.student_id AND d.record_date = #{recordDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) day
-- 누적 완독 권수 — 그 날짜까지. 첫 제출(DONE) 기준이라 합격/불합격은 따지지 않는다. OUTER APPLY ( SELECT count(*) AS totalBookCount FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = s.student_id AND rl.status = 'DONE' AND rl.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND cast(rl.completed_at AS date) <= #{recordDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) cum
WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT dd.content_id AS contentId, coalesce(dd.book_name, c.original_title) AS title, coalesce(dd.book_img, c.image_url) AS imageUrl,
-- recommend_log 쪽이 재제출까지 반영된 점수다(2026-09-21부터 처음/최종이 같은 값). -- diary_detail 스냅샷은 그 책 기록이 없을 때만 쓰는 대비책이다. isnull(coalesce(rl.final_correct_count, dd.basic_correct_cnt), 0) AS basicCorrect, isnull(dd.basic_total_cnt, 0) AS basicTotal, isnull(coalesce(dd.advanced_final_correct_cnt, dd.advanced_correct_cnt), 0) AS advancedCorrect, isnull(dd.advanced_total_cnt, 0) AS advancedTotal,
CASE WHEN retry.rounds > 0 THEN retry.rounds - 1 ELSE 0 END AS retryCount,
CASE WHEN isnull(dd.basic_total_cnt, 0) + isnull(dd.advanced_total_cnt, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cast(round( 100.0 * (isnull(coalesce(rl.final_correct_count, dd.basic_correct_cnt), 0) + isnull(coalesce(dd.advanced_final_correct_cnt, dd.advanced_correct_cnt), 0)) / (isnull(dd.basic_total_cnt, 0) + isnull(dd.advanced_total_cnt, 0)), 0) AS int) END AS correctRate
FROM erp_bookstore_diary d JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd ON dd.diary_key = d.diary_key LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = dd.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl ON rl.recommend_id = dd.recommend_id
-- 재도전 회차 수 (submitted_at 이 같으면 같은 회차). 기본 문제만 재도전 대상이다. -- "틀린 문제 다시 풀기"(WRONG_ONLY)는 점수에는 반영돼도 재도전 횟수는 올리지 않는다(2026-09-21). -- submit_mode가 NULL인 기록은 patch-260903-quiz-mode.sql 이전 것이라 재도전으로 본다. OUTER APPLY ( SELECT count(DISTINCT q.submitted_at) AS rounds FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q WHERE q.recommend_id = dd.recommend_id AND q.qlevel = '01' AND (q.submit_mode IS NULL OR q.submit_mode <> 'WRONG_ONLY') ) retry
WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId} AND d.record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY dd.id

SELECT b.badge_id AS badgeId, b.category AS category, b.badge_name AS badgeName, b.badge_desc AS badgeDesc, cast(CASE WHEN e.cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS earned, isnull(e.cnt, 0) AS earnedCount FROM erp_bookstore_badge b OUTER APPLY ( SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb WHERE sb.student_id = #{studentId} AND sb.badge_id = b.badge_id AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_diary d JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd ON dd.diary_key = d.diary_key WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId} AND d.record_date = #{recordDate} AND dd.content_id = sb.content_id ) ) e ORDER BY b.badge_id

WITH scored AS ( SELECT q.recommend_id, q.qlevel, q.qnum, q.qtype, q.is_correct, q.answer_id FROM erp_bookstore_diary d JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd ON dd.diary_key = d.diary_key JOIN erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q ON q.recommend_id = dd.recommend_id WHERE d.student_id = #{studentId} AND d.record_date = #{recordDate} AND q.qlevel = '01' AND ( q.submit_mode IS NULL OR q.submit_mode <> 'WRONG_ONLY' OR q.submitted_at = ( SELECT min(w.submitted_at) FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log w WHERE w.recommend_id = q.recommend_id AND w.qlevel = q.qlevel AND w.submit_mode = 'WRONG_ONLY' ) ) ), latest AS ( SELECT s.qtype, s.is_correct FROM scored s WHERE s.answer_id = ( SELECT max(s2.answer_id) FROM scored s2 WHERE s2.recommend_id = s.recommend_id AND s2.qlevel = s.qlevel AND s2.qnum = s.qnum ) ) SELECT cd.code AS typeCode, cd.codeNm AS typeName, cast(round(50.0 + 50.0 * sum(CASE WHEN l.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS float) AS rate, count(*) AS answerCount FROM erp_bookstore_code cd JOIN latest l ON l.qtype = cd.code WHERE cd.gubun = 'T' GROUP BY cd.code, cd.codeNm ORDER BY cd.code

SELECT TOP 6 convert(varchar(4), year(rl.completed_at)) AS year, right('0' + convert(varchar(2), month(rl.completed_at)), 2) AS month, convert(varchar(10), count(*)) AS count FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'DONE' AND rl.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND cast(rl.completed_at AS date) <= #{recordDate} GROUP BY year(rl.completed_at), month(rl.completed_at) ORDER BY year(rl.completed_at) DESC, month(rl.completed_at) DESC
